Hi Ephratah,

My name is Cassidy Dyce. I’m the founder of WB@TH and the face behind the Instagram messages from earlier today.  Nice to virtually meet you! Thank you again for reaching out and volunteering your time and services. We’re genuinely so excited to have you capture Poses & Pages.

Your work is incredible, and it truly means a lot to bring your perspective into this space. We care deeply about how this community is documented, and we’re grateful it will be through your lens!

Now allow me to share more info about the event:

Wednesday, March 11, 2026
Common Objects
2125 2nd Ave, Seattle, WA
6:00 pm to 8:00 pm PT

If you’re able to arrive between 5:30 and 5:45 pm, that would be amazing, so you can capture some of the settling-in moments and early energy.

For the evening, we’re hoping to capture:
• Edited photos that reflect the movement, creativity, and connection in the room
• A short highlight video we can share across social

Please let us know if this feels aligned on your end or if you’d prefer to adjust anything!

 After the event, we’re inviting attendees to continue the evening at Provisions Bar, which is offering 15% off for our community, along with a WB@TH signature drink. You’re more than welcome to join us and enjoy the space and community! 

We’d love to share the content across WB@TH’s social platforms and website with full credit to you. Please let us know your preferred tagging or credit details.

While I won’t be there in person, Gloria, our PNW Chapter Lead, will be your direct contact for day-of coordination and any additional logistics. I’m looping her in here so you both can connect directly.

If there’s anything that would help you prepare, please don’t hesitate to let us know. Also, as we get closer to the event, feel free to share your preferred method of communication, whether email or text.


We’re really looking forward to creating something special together.

Thank you in advance! 

 Cassidy A. Dyce 
Author, Educator and Founder of Writing Black At The House 
Visit Cassidy's Website
Social Media: Cassidy's Instagram , WB@TH Instagram

Hello Ephratah and Gloria, 

Great questions, thank you for asking! 

1. For the highlight video, something around 30-60 seconds would be perfect. Vertical 9:16 would be ideal since we're primarily using it for IG reels and other social content. Photography is a priority for us, so please focus on that first. The highlight video doesn’t need to be highly produced. If it feels easiest to capture a few intentional clips on your phone or during a specific portion of the event, that’s completely fine. Photography remains the priority, and the reel is meant to be a simple, atmospheric reflection of the evening.

2. As for lighting, for this event, we'll be meeting in Common Objects, which is a studio-like space. I will attach a few images of the last event we had in this space, and maybe that will be helpful with figuring out lighting! If the pictures do not help you, then I can provide further direction. I also think it's important to let you know that while our event is going on, there is a gallery that is installed. Gloria is going to check out the event space somewhere between the 8th and the 10th, so she can take more pictures, and you can also get an idea of what the setup looks like.  

3. We'd LOVE to collab with you for our post, and then throughout we'll reuse the images and tag you rather than collabing if that is cool with you! 

4. Digital would likely be best for our timeline. Since this is a volunteer role, we absolutely do not want you to feel rushed. If possible, we’d love a few preview images within 48 hours so we can begin sharing, and the remaining photos whenever feels reasonable on your end.
